Questions clinics ask.

How does social media management work?

We build a monthly plan and content calendar, create the content, publish and schedule it, then send a monthly performance report.

Do you create reels and video?

Yes. Reels are part of the monthly content plan, and we also run monthly mobile content shoots.

Can you manage paid ads?

Yes. Ads management is quoted separately, and ad spend is not included.

Do I need to provide photos and videos?

Models, UGC creators, locations and props are not included. We run monthly mobile content shoots and can add a professional photoshoot. Contact us to confirm what you need.

How is performance measured?

Every client receives a monthly performance report.

How long does it take to start?

Contact us for details. Timing depends on your specialty and the agreed scope.

How do we get started?

Send the consultation form or message us on WhatsApp. Payment is 50% on agreement and 50% after 15 days from the first post.
